title: Aerial battles over Basel and Nuremberg

tellings.quote: you had these huge UFO battles over various European cities and they're reflected in the broad sheets of the time, the newspapers of the time

plain: Huge battles between strange objects in the sky were seen over European cities such as Basel in Switzerland and Nuremberg in Germany, and were reported in the printed news sheets of the time, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani. He tells Michels this from his reading, pointing to those old sheets and to Wonders in the Sky, a collection of historical sightings by the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. For Jorjani it shows that people were seeing UFOs long before the modern era.
